title: 4 Filipinos injured in Riyadh airport attack; 3 admitted in ICU
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The number of Filipinos injured from the attack in an international airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia rose to four, where three of them were admitted in intensive care units…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of Filipinos injured from the attack in an international airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia rose to four, where three of them were admitted in intensive care units (ICU), the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Sunday. The DMW said that the four Filipinos are currently admitted in different hospitals in Riyadh. The agency did not disclose their identities. “Batay sa ulat ni Labor Attache Dominador Salonga ng Migrant Workers Office (MWO)- Riyadh, tatlo ang kasalukuyang nasa ICU samantalang ang isa ay set for discharge from the hospital,” the DMW said in a statement.
